description: A raw gameplay recording (up to 10 min) to a 16:9 Steam trailer, a 9:16 short and a store GIF: picks the action by motion and sound, skips menus and loading, hook first, cuts on the music's beat, vertical crop follows the action, -14 LUFS, optional end card; plus the edit list. Price: $0.40 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Store assets: Release art from one key art: every Steam store and library capsule at the exact required size with your logo placed per Steam's rules (never on the Library Hero), and full icon sets for iOS, Android adaptive icons, Google Play and the web..

endText.description: Optional end card line, e.g. "Wishlist on Steam".

logo.description: Optional logo (PNG with transparency) for the end card.

music.description: Optional music track as base64 (mp3, ogg, wav, m4a). Cuts land on its beat and the game sound is ducked under it.

video.description: Gameplay recording as base64 (mp4, mov, webm, mkv), up to about 35 MB. Longer recordings: videoUrl.

videoUrl.description: Link to the recording, up to 10 minutes and 500 MB.
